name: QuickBooks Online

agent.name: Digits
does: Reconciles bank and card accounts around the clock
Produces live P&L, balance sheet and cash flow

whatYouLose: QuickBooks' huge ecosystem of apps and accountants
Inventory and built-in payroll; Digits connects to payroll instead
notes: Digits keeps the books itself, so for a small US service business it can replace QuickBooks plus much of a bookkeeper's monthly work. Have an accountant review before tax time.
